Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization, and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across  5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%. 

Job Description

Join Miratech as an Software Engineer and play a key role in shaping our group finance system. The purpose of this role is to build, maintain, and extend Miratech’s new finance system on Odoo 20, ensuring robust customisations, integrations, and data migration. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining Odoo customisations for finance and project-management systems, including a custom expense application. Your work will include building integrations with business applications such as Microsoft Dynamics and Zoho, and migrating historical data using scripted, repeatable loads. You will collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, maintain testing pipelines, and keep technical documentation current. This role offers the opportunity to use AI coding tools in day-to-day development and support the finance automation programme.

Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and maintain Odoo customisations (back end and front end) for finance and project-management systems, including a custom expense application.
  • Build and maintain integrations with Miratech’s business applications (Microsoft Dynamics, Zoho, banking).
  • Migrate historical data using scripted, repeatable loads validated against source, through dry runs and at cutover.
  • Build and maintain testing pipelines, including test and mock data.
  • Collaborate daily with the Odoo Functional Consultant on requirements and solution options, and with the Project Manager on estimates, progress, and risks.
  • Keep technical documentation current and support the system post go-live.
  • Perform other duties as may be required consistent with the purpose of this role.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of commercial Python development, including 2+ years building custom Odoo modules on recent Odoo versions.
  • Strong expertise in Odoo development, including back-end (ORM, inheritance, security, reports, scheduled actions) and front-end (OWL, JavaScript) technologies, with experience building custom user-facing Odoo application.
  • Experience integrating Odoo with external systems using REST APIs and Odoo external APIs, including implementation of robust error handling mechanisms.
  • Hands-on experience with data migration projects, including scripted and repeatable data loads, validation, and data quality assurance.
  • Proficiency with PostgreSQL, Git, Linux, Docker, and Odoo deployment and maintenance practices.
  • Strong testing discipline, including automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, test data management, as well as demonstrated initiative and ability to deliver independently.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Ukrainian.

Additional Information

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth. 
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program. 
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities. 
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries. 
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events. 
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality. 

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.
